title: Bathsheba and Uriah
reflectionText: David managed all of it — the summons, the wine, the battle line, the letter carried by the very man it condemned. One thing he could not manage. When it was all arranged, and Uriah was in the ground, and Bathsheba was in his house, the thing he had done was still displeasing to Yahweh.
